name: Volumetric Mesh
description: Sample a volumetric object over a box and build the surface as a Rhino mesh.

inputParameters.name: bounds
inputParameters.description: The box to sample over. Only its axis-aligned extent is used.

inputParameters.name: level
inputParameters.description: Iso-value. 0 is the surface; positive offsets outward.

outputParameters.name: seconds
outputParameters.description: How long it took, to calibrate the resolution.
